methods.name: human-in-the-loop co-composition
methods.description: Process at the top level where the model generates multiple samples, a person picks a favorite by listening to rough VQ-VAE decodings, and the model continues generating multiple samples continuing the favorite.

methods.name: distillation
methods.description: Distills information from a model with fast parallel evaluation of likelihood and slow autoregressive sampling into a model with fast parallel sampling by generating samples, evaluating likelihood and entropy, and minimising KL divergence.

methods.name: raw audio hierarchical VQ-VAE
methods.description: Hierarchical VQ-VAE model trained on raw audio, tested with bottom layers explicitly modeling residuals to push information to higher levels.

methods.name: separate autoencoders
methods.description: An approach using separate autoencoders found to be cleaner and more effective than hierarchical VQ-VAE for raw audio modeling.

methods.name: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs)
methods.description: Generative models using generator and discriminator networks contesting each other to produce realistic samples.

methods.name: ancestral sampling
methods.description: generating multiple continuations from the same initial segment to explore diversity through a branching tree

methods.name: Jukebox
methods.description: a model capable of conditioning on various styles, lyrics, and raw audio to generate songs

methods.name: VQ-VAE
methods.description: Used with 44 kHz sampling rate to improve sample fidelity and reduce noise in upsampling and decoding steps.

methods.name: seq2seq model with lyric conditioning
methods.description: Sequence-to-sequence model trained with lyric conditioning on songs primarily in English to make singing intelligible and controllable.

methods.name: WaveNet
methods.description: Autoregressive model conditioning on acoustic features or spectrograms that uses a categorical distribution for audio samples

methods.name: Parallel WaveNet
methods.description: Uses a mixture of logistics distribution and probability density distillation to learn a parallel feed-forward network from a pre-trained autoregressive model for faster sampling

methods.name: ClariNet
methods.description: Audio generation model using a simple Gaussian distribution with a closed-form loss function, eliminating the need for Monte-Carlo sampling

methods.name: SampleRNN
methods.description: Uses a multi-scale, hierarchical recurrent neural network with convolutional upsampling to model long-range complex structures

methods.name: WaveRNN
methods.description: Uses recurrent neural networks operating separately on the most significant and least significant bytes for efficient deployment on mobile devices

methods.name: WaveGlow
methods.description: A flow-based model for parallel sample-level audio synthesis trained with maximum-likelihood estimation

methods.name: Adam
methods.description: Optimizer used for training with learning rate 0.00015 and weight decay 0.002

methods.name: lyrics conditioning
methods.description: Reuses the prior and adds a small encoder, trained on 512 V100s for 2 weeks

methods.name: Opus codec
methods.description: Baseline codec that encodes audio at constant bitrates comparable to the VQ-VAE.

methods.name: Spectral convergence
methods.description: Metric measuring the amount of spectral error relative to signal, used as test error and proxy for reconstruction fidelity.

evaluation_results.metric: time to upsample one minute of top level tokens
